title: Claude Code for Financial Services: Learn from Boris Cherny, Head of Claude Code
description:
Join Boris Cherny, the inventor of Claude Code, for a hands-on session built for FSI engineering teams.

See live demonstrations of Claude Code and Agent SDK powering real workflows, from SWE agents that accelerate development to compliance and claims agents that automate complex review processes.

You'll also hear how other financial services teams are putting these tools into production and learn practical approaches you can apply to your own deployments.

Target Audience: Technical teams looking to deepen their Claude Code deployments
